source.name: The District Press – 'DC United reveals 2026 Home Kit'
source.quote: The Guidehouse sponsor along with the Fruitist and Apple TV sleeve sponsors are in white, along with the Adidas logo on the right chest.
source.note: Guidehouse has been the front-of-kit partner since 2024 (reported by Sportico on Feb 15, 2024; deal dc-united-guidehouse-front).

source.name: The District Press – 'DC United reveals 2026 Home Kit'
source.quote: The Guidehouse sponsor along with the Fruitist and Apple TV sleeve sponsors are in white, along with the Adidas logo on the right chest.
source.note: Sleeve-patch partner since 2024; the club's announcement of Feb 23, 2024 places The Fruitist logo on the right sleeve. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey review also lists The Fruitist on D.C. United's right sleeve.

source.name: The District Press – 'DC United reveals 2026 Home Kit'
source.quote: The Guidehouse sponsor along with the Fruitist and Apple TV sleeve sponsors are in white, along with the Adidas logo on the right chest.
source.note: League-wide Apple TV patch on the left sleeve of every MLS kit (see deal mls-apple-tv); For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey review lists Apple TV on D.C. United's left sleeve.

summary: Black-and-red adidas home kit. Guidehouse fronts the jersey; The Fruitist patch is on the right sleeve and the Apple TV league patch on the left.
